content.text: A woman has been arrested on suspicion of attempted murder after a man was stabbed outside a house in Leicester.
Officers were called to Lawford Road shortly after 21:15 BST on Friday by the ambulance service after the man was stabbed in Sturdee Road.
A woman has been arrested on suspicion of attempted murder after a man was stabbed outside a house in Leicester.
Det Sgt Adrian Davies: It was still light at that time and with the weather being very warm there were probably quite a few people who were in the area or in their gardens.
